description: Scheduler currently uses CronTrigger(hour=SYNC_HOUR_UTC, minute=0) so the finest granularity is hourly. Add either: (a) a SYNC_INTERVAL_MINUTES env var that uses an interval trigger instead, or (b) multi-run cron ('every 4 hours'). Note: SimpleFIN itself only refreshes 1-4x per day, so this is more about catching mid-day transactions than true freshness.
title: Sub-hour sync schedule option
